data.name: ContextHelp
data.value: Aggregate CPU load/frequency, memory, battery watts, display state, brightness, power profile and available temperatures. No process names or online telemetry. Missing sensors stay unavailable; ACPI zones are not CPU temperature. More data does not guarantee better accuracy.

data.name: ContextIntervalHelp
